settings.guestNote: Your courses, grades and study sessions stay on this device. Sign in to sync them with Nexus Command Center across your devices.
settings.avatarNote: Photos are resized on your device before upload, and location data is removed. Only you can see your avatar.
settings.avatarBadType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
settings.avatarBadImage: That file couldn't be read as an image.
settings.avatarTooLarge: That image is too large even after resizing.
settings.signOutConfirm: Sign out of StudyDesk? Your synced data stays in the cloud and will reappear when you sign back in.
settings.syncNote: Realtime pushes inbound changes within ~1.5s. Outbound writes go through a local outbox that retries automatically on network restore and app resume.
settings.gradeNote: IB: weighted average on the 1–7 scale. US: per-course percent → 4.0 grade points, then credit-weighted. Stored locally — does not sync.
settings.yourDataNote: Download everything StudyDesk holds about you, or delete it permanently. No need to ask us.
settings.aiDebriefOnNote: On — after a study session you can write a note and have Google Gemini pull out the topic, how well you understood it, and anything confusing. The note you type is what gets sent.
settings.aiDebriefOffNote: Off — nothing is sent to Google. Everything else in StudyDesk works exactly the same.
settings.aiTrainingNote: Google runs this on their free tier, which means what you send may be used to train their future models. Leave it off if that is not for you.
settings.deleteAccountNote: Permanently erases your account, courses, grades and study sessions. This cannot be undone and there is no recovery window.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm1: Delete your account and all of your data? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm2: Last chance — everything will be erased immediately. Continue?
settings.deleteAccountDone: Your account and data have been deleted.
settings.remindersOnNote: On — you'll get a daily digest and alerts before assignments and exams are due.
settings.remindersOffNote: Off — no notifications, and StudyDesk will not ask for notification permission.
settings.gradeNoteCustom: Your own numeric scale — the average is a straight weighted mean, as with IB. Stored on this device only; it does not sync. Your school's official calculation is always the one that counts.
settings.supportDevSub: A link to Ko-fi. Nothing in the app is locked behind it.
settings.supporterNote: Your support keeps StudyDesk free and open for everyone else.
settings.kofiEmailWhy: Ko-fi tells us the email you paid with. If that is different from the one you signed up with, add it here and we can match them up.
settings.kofiEmailSaved: Saved. If a payment matches, it will appear shortly.
settings.kofiEmailMatched: Matched — thank you for supporting StudyDesk
settings.kofiEmailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
settings.focusChipOnNote: A live countdown appears in the status bar and, on One UI 8, in the Now Bar.
settings.focusChipOnNoteLegacy: A live countdown appears in the status bar while a block runs.
settings.focusChipOffNote: No notification while a block runs.
settings.focusChipBlocked: Android is blocking StudyDesk’s notifications, so the focus chip cannot appear.
settings.focusChipUnblocked: Notifications allowed — the focus chip will appear.
settings.focusChipStillBlocked: Still blocked. Turn notifications on for StudyDesk in Android settings.
settings.focusPinOnNote: Android pins the screen when a block starts. Hold Back + Recents to leave.
settings.focusPinOffNote: You can switch apps freely during a block.
settings.studyUntilOnNote: Free windows in the calendar run to {{time}}, so the evening shows up as time you can plan into.
settings.studyUntilOffNote: Free windows stop at the last thing already in your day.
settings.planRemindNote: Reminders for study blocks you have planned in the calendar.
settings.planRemindBlocked: Turn Reminders on above for these to be delivered.
settings.webNotifyNote: Reminders appear while StudyDesk is open in a tab, even in the background. They cannot arrive once the tab is closed.
settings.webNotifyDeniedNote: Your browser is blocking notifications for this site. Re-allow them in the site settings next to the address bar.
settings.feedbackBlurb: Tell the developer what's working and what isn't. Sent with your app version and platform so a report can be traced.
settings.feedbackPlaceholder: What happened, or what would you like to see?
settings.discordSub: Questions, bug reports, and what's coming next
settings.queueStoppedBody_one: One change could not be sent after several tries, so the queue stopped rather than retrying it forever. Nothing has been lost — it is still on this device.
settings.queueStoppedBody_other: {{count}} changes could not be sent after several tries, so the queue stopped rather than retrying them forever. Nothing has been lost — they are still on this device.
settings.weekStartNote: Automatic follows your language and region. Change it if your timetable starts on a different day.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.characterNote: Dark and Black are lighting — they turn the page down. Stacks and Slate are character: a library circulation desk and a chalkboard, each with its own type, rules and marks. They are not the dark option, and never were.
appearance.lockedNote: Stacks and Slate unlock for supporters. Dark and Black are free, and always will be.
appearance.lightingInThemeNote: Stacks and Slate bring their own lighting. Your choice here comes back when you switch to Studio.

feed.title: Calendar feed
feed.help: Most school systems publish a private calendar address you can subscribe to — look for "Calendar feed", "Subscribe" or an .ics link on your calendar page. It works with Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard, Google Classroom and most university timetables.
feed.limits: Due dates, titles and descriptions arrive on their own. Assignment type, points and submission status are not part of a calendar feed, so they will not appear.
feed.deviceOnly: The address is kept on this device only and never synced — anyone who has it can read your calendar. The imported dates do sync, like any other assignment.

err.invalid-url: That does not look like a web address.
err.duplicate: You are already subscribed to that address.
err.not-found: The address returned nothing (404). Check it is the full feed link.
err.forbidden: The server refused the request. The address may have been reset — copy it again.
err.not-a-calendar: That address returned a page, not a calendar. It may be the calendar's web page rather than its feed link.
err.too-large: That feed is too large to import.
err.cors: A browser cannot fetch a calendar from another site. Use the Android app for this.

att.uncountedNote: Cancelled and rescheduled lessons are not counted — they did not happen, so they are in neither half of the percentage.
